physical_barriers.name: Zangezur Corridor
physical_barriers.temporal_variations: Established under the August 8, 2025 US-mediated peace agreement between Armenia and Azerbaijan; negotiated at the White House; connects Azerbaijan's mainland to its exclave of Nakhchivan[citation:2]
physical_barriers.stated_justification: The Republic of Azerbaijan states the corridor is necessary for connecting its mainland to the Nakhchivan exclave, providing transport and economic integration. The agreement was reached as part of the peace deal with Armenia[citation:2]
physical_barriers.opposing_characterization: Armenian rights advocates and other regional actors (notably Russia and Iran) have expressed security concerns about the corridor. The corridor has been characterized as a factor reshaping the geopolitical balance of the Caucasus region and weakening Russia's traditional dominance[citation:2]
